newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria introduces five-day working week.
newsitem.headline: Algeria introduces five-day working week.

text.p: Algeria is cutting the standard working week to five days from six, Algerian state radio reported on Tuesday.

It said that from now on the working week would run from Saturday to Wednesday. The working day would start at 8.a.m (0700 GMT) and end at 4.30 p.m. (1530 GMT) with a one-hour break for lunch at 1.0 p.m.
Algerian employees worked six days per week and eight hours a day until the change, introduced by a law aimed at creating new jobs to ease the country's unemployment.
More than two million people are out of work from the nearly six-million workforce.
The radio said there would be no reduction in salaries as a result of the change.
